blender-any.clarifying_question: What do you want to animate — a character, an object, a short scene?

todo.assumption: Read as a basic personal to-do list mobile app (single user, iOS) with task entry, editing and local persistence, no collaboration or sync features specified.
todo.objective: A mobile app that lets a single user create, edit, complete and organize personal to-do tasks, with data persisted across sessions.

capabilities.reason: build and ship the core task list app on iOS
design the task list, add/edit and detail screens before building
persist tasks locally so they survive app restarts and device reboots
add a widget for quickly viewing or adding todos from the home screen

rc-truck.clarifying_question: What about the RC truck do you want to build — a custom chassis/body to print, a modification to an existing one, or the full electronics from scratch?

screws.assumption: Read as a mechanical hopper that singulates and dispenses screws one at a time, counts them via sensor, and syncs inventory counts to a cloud-hosted parts database with an API, rather than just a manual counting app.
screws.objective: A device that dispenses screws one at a time, counts how many were dispensed, and updates an online inventory database of parts on hand.

capabilities.reason: must mechanically separate one screw at a time from a bulk hopper
needs to confirm a screw was dispensed and count it, likely via weight or sensor counting
microcontroller must drive the dispensing mechanism and read the counting sensor
device needs to talk to the online database server over network to report counts
parts inventory database needs a sane schema for tracking screw types and quantities
online database needs an API with auth for the device and any client to read/write part counts
hopper and chute geometry must be designed and fitted to the specific screw sizes being dispensed

knob.assumption: Read as a physical rotary knob device (magnetic encoder + motor/brake) that can be reprogrammed per-application to simulate different detents and resistance, not a software-only UI knob.
knob.objective: A single rotary knob hardware device that reads its own rotation precisely and uses motorized/magnetic resistance to simulate different configurable feel profiles (detents, end-stops, free spin) depending on which application or mode it's programmed for.

capabilities.reason: needs to read absolute rotary position precisely to know where the knob is and detect motion
a motor must apply torque against the user's hand to create resistance and detents, requiring closed-loop torque control
must design and tune the actual feel of virtual detents, springs and end-stops so they feel right when turning
the torque/position control loop must be tuned against real encoder feedback to stay stable without oscillation
firmware must run on a microcontroller to tie encoder reading, motor control and programmable profile switching together
motor driver and logic rails need to be sized and isolated so the motor doesn't disrupt the MCU/sensor

coaster.assumption: Read as a load-sensing coaster that detects drink presence/weight via a built-in scale, not a PCB art piece; assumed to show status via LEDs rather than a screen.
coaster.objective: A coaster that weighs the drink placed on it and indicates something (e.g. presence, remaining amount) using an embedded load sensor and electronics.

capabilities.reason: needs to calibrate a load cell under the coaster and convert readings to weight
needs a schematic for the load cell amp, MCU and LEDs
needs a round PCB laid out to fit inside a coaster form factor
small coaster-sized board likely needs SMD components
needs firmware to read the load cell and drive outputs
needs a printed or molded coaster body sized to hold the PCB and load cell with a drink resting on top

birds.assumption: read as a single traditional/digital illustration of shorebirds lined up along a beach, not an animation or 3D scene
birds.objective: Create a drawn illustration depicting a row of birds standing along a beach

capabilities.reason: needs correct bird anatomy, gesture, and perspective to read convincingly in a composed scene

anime90s.clarifying_question: What should this be — a short animated scene/character done in a 90s anime style, or something else like a still image or title sequence?

printed.clarifying_question: What object do you want to design and 3D print?

apothecary.assumption: Read as fan art of Apothecary Diaries characters, made via a drawing-plus-AI-image workflow (hand sketch/composition refined or stylized with an AI image model), not pure hand illustration or pure AI prompting alone.
apothecary.objective: Produce a consistent, on-model piece of fan art of Apothecary Diaries characters using a combined hand-drawing and AI image generation workflow.

capabilities.reason: need a working sketch with correct anatomy, perspective and composition as the base
drive an AI image model (img2img or similar) to achieve the intended anime look from the sketch
keep the specific Apothecary Diaries characters visually on-model and recognizable across generations
final look needs anime/cel-shaded rendering style consistent with the source material

fishtank.assumption: Read as a short stylized 3D animation: a fish (the "dish" fish/pet) in a tank looking out at a Chinese restaurant interior, not a literal food dish; focus is a single character shot with environment, not a full narrative short.
fishtank.objective: A short Blender animation depicting a fish inside a restaurant fishtank watching the Chinese restaurant scene outside the glass.

capabilities.reason: need to model the fish character and restaurant environment/tank set
need materials for water, glass tank, fish scales and restaurant set under Chinese-restaurant lighting
fish needs an armature to swim and react believably
animating the fish's gaze and swimming with convincing timing and weight is the heart of the shot
camera must be blocked to read as looking out from inside the tank toward the restaurant
need to render and composite the underwater-looking-out distortion and restaurant background

golf-mount.assumption: Read as a clamp that mounts to a golf bag strap/frame tube and holds an iPhone at an angle to film swings, not a motorized tracking mount.
golf-mount.objective: A 3D-printed mount that clamps onto a golf bag and holds an iPhone steady at a useful angle to record golf swings.

capabilities.reason: mount must clamp securely around the measured diameter of the golf bag frame/strap
design the mount body and phone cradle parametrically so dimensions can be adjusted
mount must hold the phone steady despite bag movement and swing impact vibration without blurring video
choose filament and print orientation so clamp arms withstand repeated flexing and outdoor use

gacha.assumption: Read as a mobile game where players collect anime-style character cards (gacha) who cook/produce dishes, with drop-rate gacha mechanics, progression, and touch UI, not a physical cooking simulation.
gacha.objective: A mobile gacha game where players pull anime-style character cards and use them to cook/produce dishes, progressing through collection and upgrade systems.

capabilities.reason: needs a working game loop and scene flow (menus, cooking stages, gacha pull screen, results)
needs drop rates, pity system and progression design for character pulls
player collection, currency and progress must be saved and restored reliably
touch UI for gacha pulls, cooking interactions, inventory and character screens
waifu characters need consistent visual design across many cards and art pieces
character card art needs solid drawing fundamentals to look appealing

pokemon-bin.assumption: Read as a modular stackable storage system for bulk Pokemon cards, with bins or dividers color-coded/labeled by card type (fire, water, grass, etc.), not an automated sorting machine.
pokemon-bin.objective: A set of 3D printed modular bins/dividers that let someone store and organize bulk Pokemon cards separated by energy type, identifiable by color coding.

capabilities.reason: model the bins, dividers and labels parametrically so sizes scale across the full set of type categories
dividers and card slots must be measured and fitted to standard card sleeve/box dimensions for a snug but removable fit
bins need to stack or interlock into a modular bulk storage system without separate fasteners
choosing filament and orientation so bins print cleanly and hold up to repeated handling
design a consistent color/label scheme per Pokemon type so bins are visually distinguishable at a glance
capabilities.resolve_why: same underlying concept of designing a color/type label scheme for storage bins, previously proposed and rejected

gridfinity.assumption: Read as custom gridfinity-compatible bins with cutouts profiled to fit a specific set of measured tools, rather than generic grid bins.
gridfinity.objective: A 3D-printed gridfinity-compatible organizer with tool-shaped cutouts sized to hold a specific set of hand tools in a drawer.

capabilities.reason: model gridfinity base units and bin bodies parametrically so sizes stay compatible with the grid standard
measure each tool's profile and design cutout pockets that hold it with the right friction fit
gridfinity base uses standardized interlocking/stacking features between bins and baseplate
pick filament and print orientation so cutout walls and lips hold up to repeated tool insertion/removal

ledger.assumption: Read as a mobile app ("Ledger") that tracks a user's stock portfolio with real-time prices, manual trade entry, and persistent accounts, not a blockchain/crypto ledger.
ledger.objective: A mobile app where a user logs their stock holdings/trades and sees live portfolio value, gains/losses, and performance over time.

capabilities.reason: build and ship the portfolio tracker as a mobile app
pull live stock prices from an external market data API with keys and rate limits
design schema for holdings, trades, and historical valuations
backend API with user authentication to store portfolio data per user
let user view/edit portfolio offline and sync when back online
design the portfolio dashboard and trade entry screens

dryer.assumption: Read as a wall-mounted inline device that blows heated air over a user standing in the shower, built around a blower and heating element with a waterproof enclosure, not a standalone bathroom appliance outside the shower stall.
dryer.objective: A wall-mounted shower fixture that blows heated air to dry the user's body after showering, without needing a towel.

capabilities.reason: device is mounted inside an active shower stall and must survive direct water exposure
device uses a mains-powered heating element and blower in a wet environment, requiring GFCI and isolation design
blower and heater must be sized to produce enough warm airflow to dry a body in reasonable time
enclosure and nozzle housing need to be modeled to fit mounting location and airflow path
controls button input, timing, and heater/blower sequencing logic

verstappen.assumption: Read as a short 3D animated clip of a Max Verstappen-style F1 race car driving/racing, modeled and animated in Blender, not a licensed/accurate likeness or a game.
verstappen.objective: Produce a short 3D animated video of an F1-style race car racing/driving, evoking Max Verstappen's car.

capabilities.reason: Model the race car body and track environment
Build livery materials, tire, carbon fiber and metallic paint shaders and light the scene
Rig wheels, suspension and steering for the car so it can be posed and animated
Animate the car's motion, speed, weight transfer and wheel spin so it reads as racing
Block and animate a dynamic chase/track camera to sell speed and drama
Render passes (motion blur, speed lines) and composite final color grade

gundam.assumption: Read as a desk robot resembling a Gundam head with a transforming mechanism (e.g. opening visor/panels) and pan/tilt tracking that follows a detected person with a camera, not a full humanoid robot
gundam.objective: A desktop robot shaped like a Gundam head that physically transforms (moving panels/visor) and pans/tilts to track and face a person who walks into view

capabilities.reason: model the Gundam head shell and internal mechanism mounts from measurements/reference
design the transformation linkage so panels/visor move without binding inside the head
drive multiple servos for transformation and pan/tilt motion in sequence
detect a person entering the frame from an onboard or attached camera
convert noisy person detections into smooth pan/tilt targets so head tracking doesn't jitter
firmware to coordinate camera input, tracking logic and servo sequencing
